title: HOW does an 8-ton stone pillar hang in mid-air without touching the ground? #Shorts
description:
HOW does an 8-ton stone pillar hang in mid-air without touching the ground?

Of the 70 stone pillars in the Natya Mandapa, one corner pillar does not touch the ground. You can pass a cloth or paper completely beneath it. A British engineer tried to dislodge it with iron levers in the 19th century and noticed the entire roof began cracking, proving it acts as an architectural tensile cantilever.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
